stages.title: 3 判断
stages.boundary: FIXTURE: the HTTP fixture on 127.0.0.1 answers in the provider's documented shape. Not a model, not a provider, not a live call

stages.title: 4 許可範囲のゲーム操作
stages.boundary: REAL: ⑤'s guard, MCP agent_act, the relay's checks (④'s path as it is in this repository). FAKE: the chain and the game's effects (emulated)

stages.title: 5 費用照合
stages.boundary: MOCK: measured = fixture usage × fixture book; the provider record used to settle an undecided call is a FIXTURE (the real report is an approval item)

reconcile.why: no id the provider record could be matched by (no client id, no request id): the operator decides
